Record what failed and what you checked in result.json with keys summary, root_cause, checks (an array).
manual_review: Reproduced the original symptom before editing
Changes stayed focused; no test-only production seams

cases.prompt: Review this project's quality setup and recommend the smallest useful improvement. Inspect the current command and workspace coverage. This is recommendations only; do not edit project files or install dependencies. Write proposal.json with existing_commands (array), gaps (array of objects with risk and affected_paths), recommendations (array of objects with command, scope, rationale), and limitations (array).
manual_review: Finds the omitted web workspace from executable evidence
Improvement has a runnable command and clear scope
Avoids irrelevant tooling and claims beyond static validation

cases.prompt: Use context.json and docs/plan.md to save a handoff for a fresh agent. Keep the plan authoritative and distinguish past verification from current confidence. Write handoff.json with objective, authorized, plan_path, completed (array), pending (array), verification (object with command, result, covers_current_state), and next_action. Paths must resolve from this workspace. Do not perform the pending implementation.
manual_review: Does not convert historical passing tests into current evidence
Next action addresses the actual remaining work

cases.prompt: Create a self-contained verification skill for notes.py. Use its real CLI to store a note and read it in a fresh process using isolated state. Prove persistence, capture evidence that survives cleanup, and remove owned scratch state. Save the skill under .agents/skills/verify-notes/SKILL.md and a feature map. Also write recipe.json with put (array of CLI arguments after notes.py), get (array of arguments), expected (exact retrieved text), evidence_path (a surviving file), and scratch_path (the state file cleaned up). Use relative workspace paths; use the same --state path for put and get. Execute the recipe before reporting completion.
manual_review: Generated skill is actionable and self-contained
Ran put and get in distinct processes before reporting completion
Evidence supports persistence rather than merely a success message
Owned cleanup preserves evidence and unrelated files
